# OnPini

> OnPini is the free social game you play with the people you know. You answer a deck of cards by tapping buttons, then send a link to one person or a group chat. Neither of you sees the other's answers until you have both answered. Then a reveal shows where you match and where you split.

OnPini (one word) is a trade name of GPM Holding B.V. in The Hague, the Netherlands. It is not related to PiniOn or other similarly named apps. It is available in English, Dutch, German, Spanish and Arabic, and has 61 decks and 5,660 questions live in all five languages. It is not a dating app.

## Pages

- [How it works](https://onpini.app/how-it-works): decks, the reveal, profiles and polls
- [Decks](https://onpini.app/decks): question decks by genre, such as love, family, friends and fandoms
- [Questions](https://onpini.app/questions): real cards to ask a partner, crush, best friend, group chat, parents or siblings
- [Creators](https://onpini.app/creators): how creators answer a deck once and let every fan play it
- [Our story](https://onpini.app/story): who built it and the mission
- [Support](https://onpini.app/support): help and contact
